entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi Alex. I... I hope you can help. I ordered a jersey, and I think I need to send it back. I was looking at the website and I'm just so confused by all the information.
I can certainly help you with a return. Just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it's not damaged. I think I just ordered the wrong size. This jersey is way too tight in the shoulders. I don't know if I need a return or an exchange or what the process is. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can walk you through it. It sounds like a straightforward size issue. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received it about five days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. Is that okay? I wasn't sure what the time limit was. I get so overwhelmed with these things.
That is absolutely fine. For standard items like your ClubFit jersey, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief. So you can help me send it back?

Yes, I've just approved the return in our system. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. All you need to do is package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, would you prefer a full refund or an exchange for a larger size?
Wow, okay. You're sending me the label? That's so much easier. Thank you. I think a refund would be best, just in case I get the wrong size again. I'll just reorder later. Thank you, Alex.
You are very welcome. The email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you for making it simple.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
